title: CLI/Core Parity Rules
description: Rules ensuring Evolith Core governance capabilities are exposed consistently through CLI and MCP.

rules.title: Every Executable Core Rule Has a Parity Record
rules.description: Each Core ruleset rule intended for automation MUST declare CLI status, MCP status, test status, and evidence status.
rules.validationQuery: Compare rulesets/**/*.rules.json against reference/governance/standards/vision/gap-tracking.md or generated parity manifest.

rules.title: CLI and MCP Must Use Shared Validation Logic
rules.description: A validation capability MUST NOT implement divergent business logic in CLI and MCP adapters.
rules.validationQuery: Verify CLI commands and MCP tools call shared services or use cases for the same capability.

rules.title: Equivalent CLI and MCP Results Must Be Semantically Consistent
rules.description: The same validation request through CLI and MCP MUST return the same rule outcomes, severities, and blocking status.
rules.validationQuery: Run paired CLI/MCP fixture tests and compare normalized JSON results.

rules.title: Parity Gaps Must Remain Visible
rules.description: Partial or missing parity SHOULD be documented with owner, priority, and planned closure date.
rules.validationQuery: Inspect parity tracking for owner, priority, and closure metadata.
